claim_boundary: 589.73 GB/s is a MEASURED median for ONE access pattern (f32 triad) on this exact machine with the lake fill SIGSTOPped. It is NOT the SoC theoretical roof, NOT a workload-reachable roof, and NOT a sustained figure -- no thermal campaign has been run, so thermal_envelope and sustained_behaviour are both ABSENT with reasons. Knowledge level is INSTANCE: nothing here is promoted to SOC_FAMILY, because one M3 Ultra is not evidence about M3 Ultras.
